negative_files.explanation: One private project byte changes; manifest SHA remains original.
Unsupported major version is not migrated or partially imported.
Explicit traversal path in the ZIP container.
Correct file SHA but a nonexistent typed event.locationId.
Correct SHA but duplicate owned entity ID.
Compressed text is bounded at100KB but central/local expanded sizes understate100B; reject before partial import.
Both central and local names of the second attachment become the first attachment name.
